name: Kevin C. Mercado
summary: Fourth-year BSIT student at Cordova Public College who builds web and mobile applications. My projects include an educational medicinal-plant platform, a browser-based ID photo editor, and a camera app. I am interested in AI-assisted development and practical tools for everyday use.
about: I’m Kevin, a fourth-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student at Cordova Public College in Cordova, Cebu. I started college in 2023 and enjoy learning through practical web and mobile projects.
approach: I’m interested in AI and technology trends, including AI-assisted coding. My projects give me a way to explore those interests while building tools people can use, from preparing ID photos to learning about Philippine medicinal plants.
interests: Outside development, I enjoy rock music, reading books, playing games, and outdoor activities. My other skills include bartending and multitasking.

leadership.description: I also serve as a class councilor in BSIT 4B at Cordova Public College.

education.qualification: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
